newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian interbank rates lower in meagre trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian interbank rates lower in meagre trade.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates remained lower in meagre morning trade on Wednesday after Tuesday's cut, dealers said.
"The trade started with a huge amount of money on offer," one dealer said, putting the balance at banks' accounts at 631 million kuna.
Banks borrowed only 8.5 million kuna, leaving more than 60 million on the supply side which kept the call money rate lower at 10.5 percent, after it eased 50 basis points on Tuesday.
One smaller 90-day loan was struck at 17 percent.
Overnight trade totalled 50 million kuna sought by one bank to maintain its mandatory resereve. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
